ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 85-90% low-intensity (dark) pixels vs 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in circular clusters and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following an upward and outward arc from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the proximal lower-left quadrant of the ventral surface.
